description: Search Rounder's tools by what you want done (e.g. "make a pdf smaller", "heic to jpg"). Returns matching tools, each with the tool to call and example arguments. Covers PDFs (merge, split, compress, protect, unlock, pages, watermark, text, images), images (convert, compress, resize, crop, rotate, EXIF), zip, unzip, file info, and video or audio with ffmpeg (compress, convert, trim, mute, GIF, MP3). Runs locally; files never leave this computer.
name: find-tool
title: Find a tool
